beats.say: 73 goals helped Harry Kane win football's biggest individual trophy.
That is more strikes across one single season than matches most professionals play all year.
At London's Palladium, Kane officially became the fifth Englishman ever to lift the prize.
He secured his first Men's Ballon d'Or for club and country brilliance.
Alexia Putellas also triumphed on the same night, sealing her third historic women's award.

facts: Harry Kane won the Men's Ballon d'Or for the first time in his career.
Alexia Putellas won the Women's Ballon d'Or for the third time in her career.
The ceremony took place on 26 October 2026 at the London Palladium in London.
Harry Kane scored 73 goals for club and country during the 2025 to 26 season.
Harry Kane became the fifth Englishman to win the award.
